function.name: MAP_BLOCK_COPY
function.param: Number of destiny graph inside of library
Number of source graph inside of library
Horizontal coordinate inside of source graph
Vertical coordinate inside of source graph
Width in pixels of block to copy
Height in pixels of block to copy
function.abstract: It copies a section of a graph inside of other

description.p: This function copies a section of a graphn delimited by a source coordinates (for the top left corner of the zone), a width and a height, to a destiny graph possibly in other coordinates. By the value of flags indicated it is possible to determine if the transparent pixels in the source graph are ignored (flags 0) or are copied too (flags 128).
The only limitation is that both must be in the same library. If you want to make the operation with graphs in different libraries, you have to create a copy of one of the two graphs by or .
